changed_factors: Refine Exponential Moving Prototype Flow (empf-v4 over empf-v3): (1) remove small-batch (32 <= B < 100) online prototype growth in update_emeans_prototypes so stationary B=64 continuous autoencoders (e.g. model_vae_categorical, model_vae_hard) keep K = min(max_prototypes, B) = 64 prototypes with full hit-rate EMA alpha = 0.08 instead of expanding to K = 256; (2) normalize the prototype innovation shock (shock_r2p) by total batch pairwise spread 2 * sum(Var(X)) == E[||X - X'||^2] and widen the Poisson empty-cell starvation deadband (0.35 over expected empty share) so stationary 1-mode and 2-mode mixtures stay at exact zero shock (alpha_eff == alpha) while abrupt support shifts still trigger full turnover; (3) restore empf-v2's thermal_decay = 0.95 transport smoothing horizon and dim != 1 Born-Infeld settling sharpness gain batch_gain = 6.5 + 15.5 * b_frac while keeping 1D cooled settling exclusively on dim == 1; and (4) fuse real/fake/chord torch.autograd.grad calls and scalar device-to-host syncs in _EMPFPenaltyKernel.penalty and update_emeans_prototypes while preserving exact gradients.
mechanism_rationale: In empf-v3, small-batch online prototype growth (32 <= B < 100, 2D..4D), median-distance innovation shock normalization, and reduced uncooled Born-Infeld settling gain (batch_gain=2.0 vs 6.5 at B=64) bloated model_vae_categorical (B=64, 2 Gaussian modes) from K=64 to K=256 prototypes, slowing updates 2.25x and causing a step-1000 suffix dip (passing_suffix=4 < 5), while separate real/fake/chord autograd passes and per-scalar syncs reduced wall-clock margin on 20k-step discrete coupling tasks. Fixing small-batch bank cardinality at K = min(max_prototypes, B), normalizing shock_r2p by 2 * sum(Var(X)), restoring dim != 1 Born-Infeld settling gain, and fusing autograd/scalar syncs restores B=64 VAE stability and throughput while retaining empf-v3's 1D quantile-W2 floor-subtracted cooling, Poisson empty-cell shift acceleration, and prototype-referenced deep harmonic-capture lock hysteresis.
